event_policy.state_0: open during a fully observed week
event_policy.state_1: paid_date_true: cash fully covers face less dated credit note
event_policy.state_2: writeoff_date: terminal accounting write-off without full payment
event_policy.credit_note_only: fail fast: unsupported third terminal cause; none in v4 cohort
event_policy.first_event: earliest paid_date_true or writeoff_date; reject ties and contradictory records
event_policy.censoring: administrative label_end only if no terminal event by then
event_policy.partial_week: omit all risk rows unless the entire week is observed
event_policy.inference_q90: unreached within 365 days if cumulative paid incidence < 0.9

model_selection: No validation or test tuning; compare fixed v5 to locked v4 on identical validation/test anchors
